result.title: VIVID: A Visual Harness for Agentic Video Editing
result.summary: Video editing requires agents to make editing decisions grounded in audiovisual observations and precise temporal localization, and to evaluate their effects in rendered outputs. General-purpose coding agents possess strong comprehension, reasoning, and code execution capabilities, while media interaction and evidence management mechanisms tailored to video tasks can further unlock their editing potential. We introduce VIVID, a visual harness that supports multiple native coding agents in video post-production without additional model training. VIVID provides tools for on-demand video inspection, audio analysis, and transcription, and preserves observations alongside their corresponding media versions and temporal coordinates. Agents can actively retrieve these observations as they reason, perform edits using their native coding and shell tools, and inspect rendered outputs to guide subsequent revisions. On AgenticVBench, comprising 100 tasks across Assembly, Repair, Sequencing, and Repurpose, Codex with VIVID achieves an average score of 58.6%, an improvement of 20.2 percentage points over native Codex. The same harness also integrates with Claude Code and OpenCode, achieving average scores of 55.1% and 37.1%, respectively, both substantially exceeding their native baselines. These results highlight VIVID's potential as a reusable visual harness for extending the capabilities of general-purpose coding agents to video editing.

AI.brief_summary: VIVID 提出一个无需训练的视觉工具框架，使现成编码智能体可按需检查视频画面、音频与转录，并把观察结果连同媒体版本和时间坐标一并保存，供其在推理中检索、调取并检查渲染输出后迭代修改，在 AgenticVBench 上显著提升 Codex 等多个基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「发现观察—结构化保存—按需取用—检查输出再修订」的外部证据循环，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、LOOK 阶段成本与停止决策提供参照，但对象是视频编辑任务而非 latent 推理状态，联系需核查。
